title: China's Cyberspace Administration requires firms to file their AI tools in a public algorithm registry, creating a detailed map of the country's AI ecosystem (Yi-Ling Liu/Wired)
summary: Yi-Ling Liu / Wired: China's Cyberspace Administration requires firms to file their AI tools in a public algorithm registry, creating a detailed map of the country's AI ecosystem — How the Cyberspace Administration of China inadvertently made a guide to the country's homegrown AI revolution.
